decision_rationale: This is an argument/review piece about representation, fairness, and governance, not a report of a new model. It does not describe a generative architecture or any foundation-model pretraining.

decision_rationale: The abstract describes a multimodal survival prediction framework built from deep learning features and a regularized survival model. It is predictive, not generative, and gives no foundation-model evidence.
evidence_snippet: "uncertainty-aware multimodal survival framework"; "integrates deep learning features" and "regularized survival model".
